about: The lightweight budgets' baselines (plan section 11): every accepted size of Featherweight.exe and the portable zip per compiler, and every accepted set of timings per computer, each with why. scripts\budgets.ps1 checks a build against the last entries and adds new ones with -Record; see tests\budgets\README.md.

sizes.reason: 0.9.4 as released, built by scripts\release.ps1: where the ledger starts.

D0 host and foundations: Direct3D 11 swap chain, the Painter and vector printing, the new widgets with UI Automation, side panel, status bar, command search, start screen and fwpkg. Shipped build (FW_TEST_SCREENS=OFF). Timings 19-37 % faster than 0.9.4, memory within 3 %.

timings.reason: 0.9.4 as released (scripts\release.ps1's build), the development PC's starting point. D0 must be no slower and use no more memory (plan section 11).
